name: cavemio-pagination
title: Pagination
description: Pages of a long list: the current-page mark is thrown to the new number, and in a narrow container it becomes "3 of 12" with a number that rolls.

cavemio.usage:
import { Pagination } from "@/components/pagination";

<Pagination page={page} pageCount={12} onPageChange={setPage} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- A nav landmark; the current page has aria-current="page".
- Reduced motion: the mark moves at once.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: siblings
props.description: 1 · Pages either side of the current one.
